name: Rotorlet · Gremlet #44
description:
A tiny scout machine with a rotor on its head. Hovers just high enough to see over the grass.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Rotorlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
